title: Shirtless Young Boy on Hillside Above Houses, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot depicting a young boy standing shirtless atop a sunlit, rugged hillside overlooking a small valley settlement. He is dressed in cuffed work pants or denim trousers with a belt and sturdy dark shoes. Below him, single-family homes, utility poles, and eucalyptus and pine trees dot the hillside, evoking the casual, carefree atmosphere of mid-20th-century youth in post-war American residential landscapes.
